Structural requirements (fresh contiguous FP32 [B,N/2+1,2] output on the input device, input preservation, nonzero storage offsets) all pass, and benign symmetric inputs (zeros, alternating signs, subnormals) pass — indicating a systematic FFT indexing/twiddle error in the kernel's DIF/packing path that fails on generic inputs. Since the contract requires the DFT tolerance for every legal input and this fails on plain random inputs well inside the declared domain, the verdict is reject.
